 Sage Care is a fast\-growing, early\-stage healthcare startup founded by exceptional leaders from Apple, Uber, Carbon Health and backed by top\-tier venture capital (General Catalyst, Chelsea Clinton).  Building on our successful collaborations with health systems across the U.S., we have expanded internationally to the MENA region. We are now partnering with health systems there to deploy our AI\-powered care navigation platform.
   

  

**About The Role**
 AI is moving fast. New models, new orchestration patterns, and new evaluation techniques appear every month, and some of them would make our agents meaningfully better.
   

  

 We are hiring a Software Engineer to own that pipeline from idea to evidence.
   

  

 You will stay close to what is emerging in the research community and the voice AI ecosystem, design experiments we can trust, and turn promising ideas into tested prototypes on real production data. Just as importantly, you will teach: every investigation you run ends in something the team can use, whether that is a benchmarked prototype, a technical deep\-dive, or a clear recommendation with evidence behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Track emerging techniques in voice AI and agents orchestration, and identify which ones matter for us
* Build rapid prototypes and test them against real conversation data or within engineering development process
* Run head\-to\-head evaluations of models, providers, and techniques (reasoning approaches, speech models, orchestration patterns)
* Turn every investigation into a team\-usable artifact: a benchmark, a written deep\-dive, a tech talk, or a recommendation with evidence
* Work with platform engineers to hand off validated ideas for production implementation


**Required**
**What We're Looking For**
* 3\+ years of software engineering or applied ML experience
* Strong coding skills; able to build and run your own experiments end\-to\-end without infrastructure support
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs: prompting, evaluation, and an intuition for how model behavior changes across techniques and providers
* Experimental rigor: experience designing tests with controls, baselines, and honest measurement
* A track record of teaching or knowledge transfer in some form: teaching or TA experience, workshops, technical writing, internal tech talks, well\-documented open source, or developer education
* Intellectual honesty: comfortable reporting that a promising idea did not work


**Nice to Have**
* Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in CS, ML, or a related field, or equivalent research experience
* Experience with voice or speech systems (STT, TTS, real\-time pipelines)
* Publications, technical blog posts, or open\-source work we can read
* Experience taking a prototype through to production with an engineering team
* Experience evaluating AI systems in healthcare or other high\-stakes domains


**What Success Looks Like**
* The team learns about relevant new techniques from you
* Ideas are adopted or killed based on evidence
* Validated prototypes hand off cleanly to platform engineers, with the reasoning documented
* Six months in, engineers across the team can explain why our stack makes the choices it makes
* Our AI decisions get faster and more confident because the evidence base keeps growing

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.


ABOUT THE BUSINESS APPLICATIONS TEAM

The Business Applications org builds and operates the internal systems that keep Thumbtack running at scale: Salesforce-centered workflows, admin tooling, and the integrations that connect teams across the company. We're now expanding that foundation into a broader internal platform for AI-enabled work — shared APIs, reusable integration patterns, and safe, auditable capabilities for business-critical actions. We work directly with the business teams who depend on these systems, turning complex operational needs into software that's easier to run, extend, and automate responsibly.




THE CHALLENGE

Agents can already take action inside Thumbtack's internal systems. The harder problem is making that trustworthy: giving business teams a way to configure what agents are allowed to do, review and correct their work, and see clearly what happened and why. Without that, automation stays stuck in pilots. This engineer owns the product surface that turns agent capability into something teams will actually rely on for business-critical work — and the services behind it.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and build the interfaces business teams use to configure agents, review their work, approve or correct actions, and understand what happened and why.

 - Build observability and evaluation tooling that makes agent behavior legible — where it succeeded, where it failed, and whether a change made things better.

 - Work across the stack, from React and TypeScript through service code and data models, owning features end to end through build, test, launch, and iteration.

 - Partner directly with the business teams who use what you build; translate ambiguous operational problems into working software.

 - Own the full lifecycle of your work, including monitoring and post-launch improvement.




IN ORDER TO BE SUCCESSFUL, YOU MUST BRING

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.

 - Strong frontend skills with React and TypeScript, including complex application state and data-dense interfaces.

 - Solid backend engineering ability. We use Go, PHP, and Python, and we expect strong engineers to pick up a new language.

 - Working knowledge of relational and non-relational data stores (Postgres, DynamoDB, or similar).

 - Real product judgment: you can look at a workflow, decide what to build, and say what to cut.

 - Interest in the problems that come with non-deterministic systems — uncertainty, partial failure, and designing for human correction rather than assuming a correct answer every time.

 - Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, close your own knowledge gaps, and deliver in an evolving environment.

The Opportunity
We’re seeking motivated new graduates and early-career Physician Associate/Assistants (PAs) and Family Nurse Practitioners (FNPs) who are eager to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact. As part of our supportive, collaborative team, you’ll provide exceptional care while playing a key role in improving the health and well-being of our patients. Your Impact
Provide Patient-Centered Care: Conduct health assessments, physical exams, and review medical histories to address short- and long-term patient needs while staying committed to high-quality, efficient patient care.
Assess patient health:  Interview patients, perform physical examinations, obtain, update, and study medical histories.
Determine abnormal conditions:  Administer or order diagnostic tests (e.g., x-rays, electrocardiograms, laboratory studies) and interpret test results.
Perform therapeutic procedures: Administer injections and immunizations, suture, manage wounds and infections.
Educate and Counsel: Empower patients with knowledge about their health, describe therapeutic regimens, give information on normal growth and development, discuss family planning, and wellness through counseling and guidance.
Documentation and Compliance:

Maintain a safe and clean working environment in compliance with company and state procedures, rules, and regulations.
Protect patients and employees by adhering to infection-control policies and protocols.
Comply with legal and professional requirements including studying existing and new legislation, anticipating future legislation, enforcing adherence to requirements, advising management on needed actions.
Collaborate with a Team: Work collaboratively and pro-actively with other providers and health care practitioners within your clinic to efficiently treat patients, and plan coordinated, efficient, and thoughtful dispositions (including transfer), all in a timely manner.
Continuing Education:  Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies.
Who You Are
Education, Licensure, & Certifications:
Master's degree and certification by Physician Assistant (PA) or Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) certifying body.
Must have and maintain a DEA license with no restrictions.
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification: American Heart Association or American Red Cross BLS certification. We do not accept CPR, ACLS certifications, or online only classes.
Relevant experience: Clinical experience gained through rotations or other settings in emergency medicine, urgent care, or ambulatory care is preferred.
Excellent team player : Enjoy collaborating with others and being a part of a strong team dynamic.
Proactive and confident communicator (written and verbal): Foreshadows and elevates concerns as they arise, unafraid of professional directness both with colleagues and patients.
Compassionate, authentic, and patient focused: Supports patients through kindness; demonstrating understanding for others and contributing to the creating a community of belonging.
Technically savvy: Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software and clinical management systems (EMR).
Strong knowledge of:
Principles and processes for providing customer and personal services, including customer needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of customer satisfaction.
Applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations including the requirements of the HIPAA and OSHA and applicable state rules and regulations pertinent to medical practices.
Relevant drugs and their chemical composition, structure, and properties of substances and of the chemical processes and transformations that they undergo.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 


THE ROLE

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

 - Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

 - Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

 - Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

 - Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

 - Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

 - Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

 - Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

 - Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

 - Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

 - Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

 - Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

 - Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

 


THE KIND OF BUILDER WE WANT

 - Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

 - Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

 - Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

 - Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

 - Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

 


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR

 - Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

 - People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

 - Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

 - Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

 - People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

 


LOCATION

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

 


LANGUAGE

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 


INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About aiEDU
The AI Education Project (aiEDU) is a growing 501(c)(3) non-profit that creates equitable educational experiences to excite and empower learners everywhere with AI literacy. We educate students—especially those disproportionately impacted by artificial intelligence and automation—with the conceptual knowledge and skills they need to thrive as future workers, creators, consumers, and citizens. Join us to make a difference in education and help shape a brighter future for today's and tomorrow's learners.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced engineer to build the technical foundation for aiEDU's external-facing products.
Our programming is generally live and cohort-based, but we've begun prototyping web-based products to support the tens of thousands of educators and partners in our programs each year. Our goal is to build quickly using current AI-assisted development tools and processes, without compromising quality or security.
Working with our product managers, Senior Lead of Data and Impact, and VP of Operations, you'll define the quality standards our products must meet, develop our shared technical infrastructure, own the security and integrity of our systems and data, and serve as first responder when problems arise.
You'll also make the rest of the team more technically capable — advising on engineering and security best practices, setting practical guardrails that let colleagues keep experimenting responsibly, and strengthening the technical judgment of the people around you.
⭐ Role Details
Location: This part-time, non-exempt position can be done on a flexible schedule remotely from anywhere in the U.S. with access to high speed internet.
Compensation: This is a part-time role at $150 per hour, up to 25 hours per week.
Benefits: This position is part-time and not eligible for benefits.
Start date: We’d like a candidate to start as soon as possible after receiving an offer, though there is some flexibility.
✅ Your Responsibilities (percentages fluctuate during the year and over time):
Product quality & process
Working alongside our PMs, ensure all external-facing products meet quality standards for reliability, accessibility, error handling, performance and security.
Define the bar that new features/ products must clear before they go live, and review changes to production systems and externally facing products before release.
Build shared resources — e.g., templates, authentication patterns, environment setup — that PMs or other team members can reuse for new product or feature development. Set up the basic infrastructure for new launches, including monitoring, alerts and backups.
Advise our team on when something shouldn't ship or should be retired. Keep track of what we’ve launched and shut down what is no longer used.
Security & Data Management
Audit aiEDU’s externally facing products for security vulnerabilities; scope and implement remediations.
Harden backend configurations across our Supabase and Vercel environments, and own credential and secrets hygiene.
Establish and maintain our GitHub organization’s security posture.
Serve as first responder for security incidents, including triage, remediation and documentation.
With our Sr. Lead, Data & Impact, know and document where our data lives and design and enforce controls across our data systems, including audit logging and appropriate backup, retention and deletion practices.
Support our VP of Operations to evolve our compliance and data safeguards, and ensure appropriate documentation to meet partner requirements.
Technical mentorship
Establish lightweight, realistic guardrails for AI-assisted development that allow non-technical team members to build and experiment with AI tools without putting the organization at risk.
Write and maintain plain-language documentation and runbooks that a non-engineer can actually follow.
Raise the technical judgement and ability of the people around you - the goal is to build a team that is more technically literate and competent a year from now, not one more reliant on you.
🚀 About You

Full-stack fluency sufficient to take someone else’s working prototype and make it production-grade for relatively simple, web-based products.
Experience working with AI-assisted development workflows.
Hands-on experience modern securing production databases (e.g., Supabase or similar), including access control design. Supabase or comparable platforms preferred.
Working knowledge of modern web hosting platforms (Vercel, Netlify, or similar) and how to configure them securely.
Practical experience with credential management, API security, and authentication.
Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and write documentation that teams will understand and use.
Comfort operating with autonomy in a small organization and good judgement about what’s worth fixing now vs. later.
